DECLARE
  N NUMBER;
  v_credit S_CUSTOMER.credit_rating%type;
BEGIN
  IF :S_ORD.payment_type = 'CREDIT' THEN
    SELECT credit_rating
    INTO v_credit
    FROM S_CUSTOMER
    WHERE :S_ORD.customer_id = id;
    IF v_credit NOT IN ('GOOD', 'EXCELLENT') THEN
      :S_ORD.payment_type:= 'CASH';
      n:=SHOW_ALERT('Payment_Type_Alert');
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;

triggers.name: ON-POPULATE-DETAILS
triggers.body:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
  recstat     VARCHAR2(20) := :System.record_status;   
  startitm    VARCHAR2(61) := :System.cursor_item;   
  rel_id      Relation;
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
  IF ( recstat = 'NEW' or recstat = 'INSERT' ) THEN   
    RETURN;
  END IF;
  --
  -- Begin S_ITEM detail program section
  --
  IF ( (:S_ORD.ID is not null) ) THEN   
    rel_id := Find_Relation('S_ORD.S_ORD_S_ITEM');   
    Query_Master_Details(rel_id, 'S_ITEM');   
  END IF;
  --
  -- End S_ITEM detail program section
  --

  IF ( :System.cursor_item <> startitm ) THEN     
     Go_Item(startitm);     
     Check_Package_Failure;     
  END IF;
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

triggers.name: ON-CHECK-DELETE-MASTER
triggers.body:
--
-- Begin default relation declare section
--
DECLARE
  Dummy_Define CHAR(1);
  --
  -- Begin S_ITEM detail declare section
  --
  CURSOR S_ITEM_cur IS      
    SELECT 1 FROM S_ITEM     
    WHERE ORD_ID = :S_ORD.ID;
  --
  -- End S_ITEM detail declare section
  --
--
-- End default relation declare section
--
--
-- Begin default relation program section
--
BEGIN
  --
  -- Begin S_ITEM detail program section
  --
  OPEN S_ITEM_cur;     
  FETCH S_ITEM_cur INTO Dummy_Define;     
  IF ( S_ITEM_cur%found ) THEN     
    Message('Cannot delete master record when matching detail records exist.');     
    CLOSE S_ITEM_cur;     
    RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;     
  END IF;
  CLOSE S_ITEM_cur;
  --
  -- End S_ITEM detail program section
  --
END;
--
-- End default relation program section
--

triggers.body:
DECLARE
	product_image_id	ITEM := FIND_ITEM('s_item.product_image');
	image_description_id	ITEM := FIND_ITEM('s_item.image_description');
	image_button_id		ITEM := FIND_ITEM('control.image_button');
	filename varchar2(500);
BEGIN
	IF    GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(product_image_id,displayed) = 'TRUE'
	THEN
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(product_image_id,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(image_description_id,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(image_button_id,LABEL,'Image On');
		SET_MENU_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMAGE_MENU.IMAGE_ACTIVATE', CHECKED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
	  IF  GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_ITEM.product_image',VISIBLE)='TRUE' THEN
	    filename := GET_PRODUCT_IMAGE(:S_ITEM.product_id); 
	    IF filename = 'No file' THEN  
	       null;
	    ELSE  
	      READ_IMAGE_FILE(filename,'tiff','S_ITEM.product_image');
	    END IF;
	  END IF;	
	ELSE  
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(product_image_id,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(image_description_id,DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
		SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(image_button_id,LABEL,'Image Off');
		SET_MENU_ITEM_PROPERTY('IMAGE_MENU.IMAGE_ACTIVATE', CHECKED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
	END IF;
END;

triggers.name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
triggers.body:
DECLARE
  no_rows  NUMBER(7);
  rg_id    RECORDGROUP;
BEGIN
  :GLOBAL.where_cls  := ' id NOT IN (';
  GO_BLOCK('s_item');
  FIRST_RECORD;
  IF:SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS != 'NEW' THEN
    LOOP
      :GLOBAL.where_cls := :GLOBAL.where_cls || TO_CHAR(:s_item.product_id);
      NEXT_RECORD;
      EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';  
      :GLOBAL.where_cls := :GLOBAL.where_cls || ',';
    END LOOP;
    :GLOBAL.where_cls := :GLOBAL.where_cls || ',' || TO_CHAR(:s_item.product_id) || ')';  
  END IF;
--  CALL_FORM('lov_product', NO_HIDE);  
  CALL_FORM('pick', NO_HIDE);

  GO_BLOCK('s_item');
  rg_id := FIND_GROUP('sel_records');
  IF NOT ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
    no_rows := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id);
    FOR i IN 1..no_rows LOOP
      IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS != 'NEW' THEN
        CREATE_RECORD;
      END IF;
      :s_item.product_id  := GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('sel_records.prodno', i);
      :s_item.description := GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL('sel_records.prodname', i);
      :s_item.price       := GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL('sel_records.prodprice', i);
    END LOOP;
    IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_GROUP('sel_records')) THEN
      DELETE_GROUP('sel_records');
    END IF;
  END IF;
END;
